authorization.scope: Fix citation location separately, retain semantic criteria, then repeat D06 baseline/revised comparison; at most four new calls.

change: Model evidence is one exact paragraph ID. Program resolves it to the original source slice; raw transport answer and parsed ID diagnostic remain separate from derived quotes. No output repair.
semantic_criteria: Byte-identical to contribution-v1 in both arms; unchanged component source, model and transport. System citation clause, schema enum and source catalog change in both arms.
attempt_scope: Within this new citation-contract study. D06-A is a fresh comparison under a changed contract, not a repair of the original failure; D06-B was previously unattempted.
order: D06-A baseline then revised; D06-B revised then baseline. One-attempt calls, no swapping or after-result revision.
gates: Offline fixtures and matching preflight before calls. Stop on any transport/schema/ID validation failure; no retry or partial rescue. Review all findings manually; no automatic winner or runtime adoption.
review_targets: Existing D06 feedback about shared framing and metaphor
Useful articulation of both parties' concerns

blinding.material: Existing human-labeled D06; used by older judges and partially attempted by current component. Not independent holdout.

limits: Citation granularity is a paragraph, possibly multiple sentences; reasons require manual review.
Valid IDs establish source location, not the correctness or relevance of a finding.
The changed citation protocol may affect judgments; do not pool with the prior protocol as an unchanged experiment.
No fresh live P02/P03 safeguard run under this protocol; prior safeguards belong to the old protocol.
No stability, preference accuracy, general reliability or overall superiority claim from four calls.
Retain prior failure and its cost; provider HTTP request count is unmeasured.
